rubric.role_summary: Senior talent partner advising private-equity portfolio companies on executive hiring and assessment, organizational design, and go-to-market leadership.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior talent partner advising private-equity portfolio companies on executive hiring and assessment, organizational design, and go-to-market leadership.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years of experience, with meaningful depth in People, Talent, or Organizational Effectiveness.
- Experience in executive search, leadership assessment, or organizational design.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Significant exposure to GTM and sales organizations.
- Exposure to commercial environments with fluency in comp plan design, quota-setting, territory structure, and coverage modeling.
- Prior experience as a Talent Partner, Operating Partner, or VP Talent at a PE or VC firm, or equivalent experience conducting executive assessments in a high-stakes, time-pressured context.
- Expertise in executive search best practices, leadership assessment, and organizational design.
- Ability to assess executive leadership and make recommendations on leadership fit within 30–60 days of engagement.
- History of working closely alongside a CHRO or CPO.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
